title: Route Bosses
description: Complete guide to Route Boss trainers in Pokémon Polished Crystal - defeat all trainers on a route to challenge the boss and earn rare items
html:
This guide has not been peer reviewed yet!

The information presented may be incomplete, inaccurate, or represent a single perspective. Please verify critical details independently or join the Discord for community support if needed.

Introduction

Route Bosses are special trainers found throughout Johto and Kanto. To challenge a Route Boss, you must first defeat all other trainers on that route and occasionally a neighboring route. Once you've done so, the Route Boss will accept your challenge. Defeating them rewards you with a rare and valuable item!

Route Bosses typically use teams that showcase the item they're about to give you - their Pokémon will often be holding the reward item, giving you a preview of its usefulness.

How Route Bosses Work

  1. Find the Route Boss - They're usually standing in a prominent location on the route
  2. Defeat all other trainers - The Route Boss won't battle you until everyone else is beaten
  3. Challenge the Route Boss - Talk to them after defeating all prerequisites
  4. Claim your reward - After winning, you'll receive a rare item

Route 31 - Air Balloon

Defeat these trainers first (4):
Youngster JoeyYoungster MikeyBugcatcher DonBugcatcher Wade

The Air Balloon is a held item that makes the holder immune to Ground-type moves until it takes damage from an attack.

Route 32 - Miracle Seed

Defeat these trainers first (8):
Camper RolandFisher JustinFisher RalphFisher HenryPicnicker LizYoungster AlbertYoungster GordonBirdkeeper Peter

The Miracle Seed boosts the power of Grass-type moves by 20%.

Route 34 - Big Nugget

Defeat these trainers first (5):
Camper ToddPicnicker GinaOfficerf MaraPokéfan BrandonBreeder Julie

The Big Nugget can be sold for a substantial amount of money - perfect for funding your journey!

Route 36 - Binding Band

Defeat these trainers first (7):
Schoolboy AlanPsychic MarkSchoolgirl MollyTwins AnnandannePsychic GregBeauty CallieBeauty Cassandra

The Binding Band increases damage from binding moves (like Wrap, Bind, Fire Spin) from 1/8 to 1/6 of the target's max HP per turn.

Route 39 - PP Max

Defeat these trainers first (11):
Birdkeeper TobySailor HarryLass DanaSchoolboy ChadBeauty ValenciaBeauty OliviaPokéfan DerekPokéfan RuthSailor EugenePsychic NormanPokéfan Jaime

These trainers are across Route 38 and Route 39. One of the trainers on these routes will only battle at night time!

PP Max raises the PP of one of a Pokémon's moves to its maximum possible value.

Olivine Lighthouse - Protect Pads

Defeat these trainers first (9):
Gentleman AlfredSailor HueyBirdkeeper TheoGentleman PrestonSailor TerrellLass ConnieSailor KentBirdkeeper DenisSailor Ernest

The Protect Pads prevent the holder from receiving recoil damage and protect against contact-based abilities and effects.

Route 43 - Flame Orb

Defeat these trainers first (8):
Breeder JodySr. & Jr. IvyandamyCamper SpencerPokemaniac BenPokemaniac BrentPokemaniac RonFisher MarvinPicnicker Tiffany

The Flame Orb burns the holder at the end of each turn. While this seems counterproductive, it's useful for activating abilities like Guts or preventing other status conditions.

Route 44 - Rocky Helmet

Defeat these trainers first (7):
Birdkeeper VancePsychic PhilFisher WiltonFisher EdgarAce Trainer CybilPokemaniac ZachAce Trainer Allen

The Rocky Helmet damages attacking Pokémon that make contact with the holder, dealing 1/6 of their max HP.

Route 45 - Focus Sash

Defeat these trainers first (9):
Battlegirl NozomiBlackbelt KenjiHiker ErikHiker MichaelHiker ParryHiker TimothyAce Trainer RyanAce Trainer KellyCamper Quentin

The Focus Sash allows the holder to survive any single attack that would knock it out from full HP, leaving it with 1 HP instead.

Route 27 - Choice Specs

Defeat these trainers first (14):
Psychic GilbertBirdkeeper JoseAce Trainer BlakeAce Duo JakeandbriAce Trainer ReenaAce Trainer MeganDragontamer KazuAce Trainer GavenAce Trainer JoyceAce Trainer BethPsychic RichardBattlegirl RondaFisher ScottDragontamer Erick

These trainers are across Route 26 and Route 27. You can find Litvyak early, as soon as you get access to Surf. However, you need Waterfall and Whirlpool to beat all the required trainers.

Choice Specs boost the holder's Special Attack by 50%, but lock it into the first move used until it switches out.

Tips for Route Boss Battles

  • Scout first - Route Boss teams are usually stronger than regular trainers on the route
  • Notice held items - Their Pokémon often hold the reward item, showing you how it's used
  • Badge-based levels - Many Route Bosses use Badge Level scaling, so their team strength matches your progress
  • Come prepared - Bring healing items and a balanced team

Related Guides
